# Entity duplication from conservative merging

When similarity/overlap is below configured thresholds, normalization creates a new entity rather than silently merging, which can lead to duplicate entities for the same logical item across compiles.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_normalize.py` — `tests.test_normalize.test_below_threshold_splits_not_merges`
